title: Document-level bookmark, link and attachment editing with a CLI host
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-edit --lib navigation::document_navigation, cargo test -p pdfxi-edit --test real_document_navigation and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli pass; pdfxi outline/link/attach edits real bookmarks, links and embedded files that survive a save and read back; EDIT-011 moves to verified.
notes: Adds add_link/remove_link and add_attachment/remove_attachment writers that stage into a real Document, plus pdfxi outline/link/attach hosts. Writers reparse staged changes so several edits chain into one save.
